sources.quote: 8.7.1.1 A temporary deviation is requested through the supplier portal and needs approval before shipment.
BR-220 at TO1 for STL has one approved material source: Alluminio B S.r.l. (Settimo Torinese).

findings.why: BR-220 is an STL part. The proposed temporary deviation falls under the STL requirement, which needs approval through the portal before shipment. No approval is in the documents, so nothing in force covers it.

sources.quote: 5. Material certificate EN 10204 type 3.1 required with each lot.
Rev C, 2026-06-01: material changed from EN AW-6061-T6 to EN AW-6082-T6

findings.why: Drawing Rev C requires a 3.1 certificate for each lot, and the material is EN AW-6082-T6. The documents hold no certificate or test result for the lots to be shipped under the deviation. A person must confirm that a certificate exists for the 6082-T6 material.
